title: Abagambanyi b'abatoranijwe
intro: Mu mateka yose, intumwa z'Imana zagendaga mu bantu, kandi bamwe mu bari hafi yabo ntibashoboye kumenya umucyo. Iyi nkuru ivuga ku bantu babiri begereye ubuhanuzi, kandi umurage wabo ukaba isomo ridashira.
clues: Twabayeho mu bihe by'abahanuzi bakomeye, ariko amaso yacu yakomeje gupfukirana ukuri bazanye.
Ingo zacu zari zuzuye ihishurirwa ry’Imana, ariko imitima yacu yari yaranangiye.
Twari twashakanye n'abagabo batoranyijwe kugira ngo baburire abantu babo.
Igihe igihano cyageraga, ntitwashatse aho twikinga mu nkuge cyangwa ngo duhunge imvura igurumana, kuko twasetse imiburo.
Muri Korowani havugwamo urugero rw'abatemera, bigaragaza ko nubwo umuntu yaba afite ubucuti bwa hafi n'umuhanuzi, ntakiza.
Turi abagore ba Nuh na Lut, babagambaniye bityo bagacirwaho iteka.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
